briefdescription.para: Unit tests for RAGContextAssembler — Greedy Fill with Response Guard.

detaileddescription.para: Test suite: RagContextAssemblerFocusedTests (32 tests) Group A (5) – empty input edge cases Group B (5) – single chunk: fits, too large, truncation Group C (6) – multiple chunks: greedy fill in relevance order Group D (5) – response-guard: tokens_remaining_for_response Group E (5) – truncation marker and allow_partial_chunk flag Group F (6) – computeMaxTokens static helper
